# Ali Abdelhadi

> Freelance Senior Software Developer (Mobile & Full-Stack) based in Beirut, Lebanon. 4+ years building production-grade mobile and web applications from architecture through release: mobile apps, web platforms, backend systems, payments, real-time systems, AI integrations and automation.

- Stack: Flutter, Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, Angular, ASP.NET/.NET Core, Laravel, MSSQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Stripe/Areeba/Monty payments, SignalR, n8n, AI APIs
- Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Lebanese International University (2021)
- Languages: English, Arabic, French
- Contact: WhatsApp +961 76 618 326

## Services (hire for these)

- [Flutter & mobile app development](https://aliabedelhadi.com/services/flutter-app-development): iOS and Android apps with Flutter, native Android with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, through store release
- [Payment gateway integration](https://aliabedelhadi.com/services/payment-integration): Stripe, Areeba and Monty; one-time and recurring payments with server-side webhooks
- [Web & backend development](https://aliabedelhadi.com/services/web-development): ASP.NET/.NET Core, Angular and Laravel platforms, e-commerce, dashboards, CRMs, real-time systems
- [AI integration & workflow automation](https://aliabedelhadi.com/services/ai-automation): AI APIs and n8n workflows connected to existing business systems

Available for freelance projects in Lebanon and remotely. Contact via WhatsApp +961 76 618 326 or the portfolio site.

## Selected projects

- [CCCL](https://www.cccl.org.lb/): donation platform with one-time and recurring giving, payment providers and transaction workflows (.NET, Angular, Stripe, Areeba, Monty, SQL)
- [MedVault](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gtonics.medvault): healthcare app connecting patients with clinics to view and track lab results securely (Flutter, iOS + Android)
- [Unipak The Shop](https://www.unipaktheshop.com/): complete e-commerce store for a packaging manufacturer: catalog, cart, checkout, orders, API and database
- [YMP](https://www.ymplebanon.com/): real-time voting system (ASP.NET, SignalR) that handled up to 2M requests and 30,000 votes on election day
- [GS1 Lebanon](https://www.gs1lebanon.org/): ASP.NET system replacing a manual process for issuing barcodes, invoices and certificates
- [Mohamad Elhabib Real Estate](https://alhabib.37-187-35-120.plesk.page/): property listings with business logic, calculators and lead integrations
